question: How do I roll back a bad production deployment?

sops.title: Production Deployment and Rollback
sops.content:
## Standard Deployment
Merge your PR to main after 2 approvals and passing CI checks.

## Emergency Rollback
To roll back a bad production release, run `argocd app rollback prod-api` or revert the merge commit on main and notify #deployments.

sops.title: On-Call Escalation Policy
sops.content:
## Severity 1 Incidents
Page the primary on-call engineer via PagerDuty and open an incident channel using `/inc open` in Slack.
